title: Meagan The Stallion Sounds Off-On Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson Wanting To Be Her Pet
htmlContent:
Megan Thee Stallion's Traumazine marketing campaign continues with new footage of her responding to Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson announcing in the headlines that she wants to be her "pet."

Johnson was on a prom run (see above) for his animation film and Kevin Hart DC League of Super-Pets when he named Megan after being asked to reveal what celebrity he would want to be an "animal" for, which later inspires a playfully disinterested response from Megan's boyfriend, Pardison Fontaine.

Of all the things to be worried about y’all think I’m mad at the Rock,” he said earlier this week.

During an appearance on SiriusXM Hits 1' Morning Mash Up Show, Megan was invited to share her own thoughts on the clip, resulting in a hilarious insight into the concept of fame.

The Stallion would respond to The Rock with, “I mean, that’s kinda, like, legendary,” Megan said.

“I’m kinda epic. I feel like I used to watch wrestling all the time and, like, being from Houston and watching The Rock and how famous he is and how much of a megastar he is. And he wants to be my pet? Like, period. We made it. We might be a little famous.”

As part of the takeover of Traumazine, Megan co-hosted Thursday's Tonight Show with Jimmy Fallon.

During the interview, Megan and Jimmy got to the root of Hot Cheetos, including a preview of a pre-launch Roc Nation meeting at which Jay-Z made a pop-in surprise (as well as a complete spread of Hot Cheetos).
